b2-26-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Guess From the Evidence
b2-26-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says that his boss is not answering the phone. You guess that the boss is in a meeting.
b2-26-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what you guess about his boss.
cues: Say that he is not answering
Guess where he is, with deber de
b2-26-01.target: Tu jefe no contesta; debe de estar en una reunión.
b2-26-01.english: Your boss is not answering; he must be in a meeting.
b2-26-01.canDo: I can use deber + infinitive for a duty and deber de + infinitive for a guess.

b2-26-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Formal Duty
b2-26-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you must do before Friday. You must hand in a report, and you want to say it in a formal way, with haber de.
b2-26-02.prompt: Tell Meg, in a formal way, what you must do before Friday.
cues: Say what you must hand in
b2-26-02.target: He de entregar el informe antes del viernes.
b2-26-02.english: I must hand in the report before Friday.
b2-26-02.canDo: I can use haber de + infinitive for a formal duty.

b2-26-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Need and Its Reason
b2-26-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks you to come out tonight. You cannot, because you have to study and you have a lot of work.
b2-26-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you cannot come and why.
cues: Say what you have to do and give the reason
b2-26-03.target: Lo siento, tengo que estudiar porque tengo mucho trabajo.
b2-26-03.english: I am sorry, I have to study because I have a lot of work.
b2-26-03.canDo: I can use tener que for a need that comes from the situation, and give the reason.

b2-26-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Rule at the Door
b2-26-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how to get into your office building. The rule is the same for everybody: you have to show a card at the door.
b2-26-04.prompt: Tell Meg the rule for getting into the building.
cues: Say where you have to show it
b2-26-04.target: Para entrar a la oficina hay que mostrar la tarjeta en la puerta.
b2-26-04.english: To get into the office you have to show the card at the door.
b2-26-04.canDo: I can use hay que for a rule or a need that is the same for everyone.

b2-26-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Will It Rain?
b2-26-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks if you will take an umbrella today in Budapest. There are many clouds, so it may rain this afternoon.
b2-26-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that it may rain and why you think so.
cues: Say that it may rain this afternoon, with puede que
b2-26-05.target: Puede que llueva esta tarde, porque hay muchas nubes.
b2-26-05.english: It may rain this afternoon, because there are many clouds.
b2-26-05.canDo: I can guess with deber de, poder and tener que, and show how sure I am.

b2-26-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: People Outside the Office
b2-26-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why people are waiting outside your office. You guess that there is a meeting, and everybody has to wait outside.
b2-26-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you guess and what everybody has to do.
cues: Guess why the people are there
Say what everybody has to do
b2-26-consolidation.target: Debe de haber una reunión y hay que esperar fuera.
b2-26-consolidation.english: There must be a meeting and you have to wait outside.
b2-26-consolidation.canDo: I can tell deber, deber de, haber de, tener que and hay que apart.
